desc: Ideate approaches; select banded Ukkonen DP as the reliable O(nK) method.
Implement the complete banded Ukkonen DP solution with early checks, common prefix/suffix trimming, sentinel target byte, capped values, and final diagonal check.
Verify the implementation on the three samples and edge cases (equal strings, length difference > K, K=1/K=20, prefix/suffix trimming, small random brute-force equivalence).
Confirm performance is O(nK) with K <= 20 and early exits; no fallback needed.
